title: Oni Press announces Tales of Lake Eerie, cryptid mystery for young readers
excerpt: Oni Press expands its children's catalog with Tales of Lake Eerie, a middle-grade mystery graphic novel series by David M. Booher and Sarah K. Turner, described as a crossover between Scooby Doo and The Last Kids on Earth. The first volume, Jake in the Lake, arrives on September 14, 2027.
content:
Oni Press expands its children's catalog with Tales of Lake Eerie, a middle-grade mystery graphic novel series created by David M. Booher and Sarah K. Turner. The work is described as a cross between Scooby Doo and The Last Kids on Earth. The first volume, Jake in the Lake, arrives on September 14, 2027 with a cover revealed exclusively.

Visual investigation and cryptids: the narrative mechanics of the series 🔍

The proposal follows three twelve-year-old friends, founders of the Weirdologists of Sperryville, Ohio, who investigate cryptid and ghost sightings near Lake Erie. Their search for an aquatic monster leads them to the old lighthouse and its keeper, Bones Braddock. The visual investigation work functions as the narrative engine: clues are built from what the characters observe and record. The series reinforces Oni Press's children's catalog by betting on supernatural mystery.

Three kids, a lighthouse, and a keeper who surely isn't hiding anything 🏮

Nothing reassures parents more than their twelve-year-old founding a club called the Weirdologists and going out at night to look for aquatic monsters near a lighthouse inhabited by someone named Bones. If the keeper offers them a free tour and a sandwich, the investigation will be over before it begins. Mystery is guaranteed; adult supervision, pending confirmation.
